title: Sumoplugin
description: A easy Sumo plugin that work out-of-the-box
body:
# **SumoPlugin** 

SumoPlugin is a Sumo plugin that is easy to setup and use

## Permissions:

* sumo.use = normal command (gui, stats)
* sumoplugin.admin = admin command (arena, general, reload)

## Papi:

* %sumo_wins% = get player wins
* %sumo_losses% = get player losses

## Commands

### Normal commands
* /sumo gui = Open the arena selection gui
* /sumo stats = View your stats

### Admin commands
* /sumo arena create <name> = Create an arena
* /sumo arena setspawn <arena> <1|2> = set spawn for player 1 and 2 when the game start
* /sumo arena setlobby <arena> = set waiting lobby spawn for when player wait the game to start
* /sumo general setlobby = set the main lobby for when the player will finish the game
* /sumo general setip <ip> = set the server ip that player will see in the scoreboard
* /sumo reload = reload the plugin configuration

## Note:
  
Make sure to have water down the ring or the arena will not work
